title: A lightweight NbMoZrTi refractory high entropy alloy with high specific strength
process_description: prepared by WK-II type non-self-consuming vacuum arc furnace using pure metals of Nb, Mo, Zr and Ti (>99.9 wt %). The alloy ingots (60 g by weight) were remelted at least 8 times, kept in a liquid state for 10 min during each melting, and turned before remelting to achieve chemical homogeneity.
